core_claims.name: Refutes / notElim / doubleNegIntro / tripleNegElim / contraposition / oneNotTwo / zeroNotSucc
core_claims.scope: Constructive negation as a function to Void, explosion from actual contradiction, double-negation introduction, triple-negation elimination, contraposition, and constructor-based natural inequality.

core_claims.name: negationsPointwise / notSum / notSumRound
core_claims.scope: Refutations agree pointwise at each possible input; a refuted sum is logically equivalent to a pair of refutations. Whole-function equality is not asserted.

core_claims.name: excludedMiddleIrrefutable
core_claims.scope: For any proposition a, double negation of Either a (Refutes a), without constructing excluded middle itself.

core_claims.name: ExclusiveTri / exclusiveTrichotomy
core_claims.scope: For every pair of naturals, one ordering alternative with explicit refutations of both incompatible alternatives.

core_claims.name: emToDne / dneToEm / emToPeirce / peirceToEm / emToImplication / implicationToEm / emToDeMorgan / deMorganToEm
core_claims.scope: All five polymorphic classical principles imply each other via explicit principle arguments and constructive functions. No unconditional inhabitant of a classical principle type is introduced.

core_claims.name: negationStable / productStable
core_claims.scope: Every negation is stable under double-negation elimination; the product of two explicitly stable propositions is stable.

deviations: Refutes avoids colliding with Idris numeric Neg.
Upstream assimilation equality for whole negation functions is replaced by negationsPointwise; notSum is an Iff without the extensionality-dependent Iso upgrade.
Classical principles appear solely as explicitly quantified premises, never as postulates.

verification.compiler: Idris2 0.8.0 via the pinned Nix environment
verification.totality: %default total; no proof holes, postulates, unsafe casts or termination overrides
verification.independent_acceptance: Recorded separately by the primary editor and independent reviewer
